items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: I called the hotel... told him the situation... I called Jaffe and I told him to bring punch around... Jaffe got to the concert with, with punch... Louis got him backstage

ctx.x: With Punch Miller, you know, the story that's in the, I Remember Jazz. Uh-huh. He was staying in the Roosevelt then. Yeah. But, uh, what happened there was that I called, no, what happened then was that Punch Miller had gone out with a lot of other people to the airport to meet Louie, Louie's plane.
